section_summary: This section tracks Japanese merchant vessels through ports in the Americas, Japan, Australia, and New Zealand in late June and early July 1941. Many incoming telegrams are followed by paraphrases sent to the U.S. Navy. The section also contains reports on fuel sales in the Philippines, vessel requisitions and recalls, and a confidential FBI letter about a change in Osaka Shosen Kaisha routes.

subfiles.title: Continuation of report on the Heshin Maru
subfiles.about: Officers obtained a receipt for returned documents and assent to forfeiture of a bottle of oroin.
subfiles.summary: Road, tire, and shipboard delays preceded the receipt and forfeiture assent.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru movement at Callao
subfiles.about: The Naruto Maru arrived at Callao and departed for Valparaíso via Arica.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrival from Kobe via Buenaventura on June 25 and departure June 26.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Naruto Maru movement
subfiles.about: Relays the Naruto Maru's Callao arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases McGurk's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Yamazuki Maru movement at Santos
subfiles.about: The Yamazuki Maru sailed from Santos toward Japan.
subfiles.summary: Reports arrival from Buenos Aires June 23 and sailing via Panama Canal and Los Angeles June 28.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Yamazuki Maru movement
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamazuki Maru's Santos itinerary.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Parsloe's sailing report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru and Ginyo Maru movements
subfiles.about: Reports movements of the Sagami Maru and Ginyo Maru on the Chilean coast.
subfiles.summary: Sagami Maru sailed for Iquique; Ginyo Maru arrived from Taltal and planned to sail for Tocopilla.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Chilean vessel movements
subfiles.about: Relays the Sagami Maru and Ginyo Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Adams's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Haruna departure for Batavia
subfiles.about: Reports that the Haruna cleared for Batavia.
subfiles.summary: The reported departure occurred June 24.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Haruna departure
subfiles.about: Relays the Haruna's reported departure for Batavia.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: High Commissioner's letter on oil company reports
subfiles.from: Claude A. Buss, for the U.S. High Commissioner
subfiles.about: Forwards four companies' April petroleum sales reports and discusses an unfilled French shipping oil inquiry.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the reports and states that no company supplied the requested oil.

subfiles.title: Caltex April petroleum sales report
subfiles.about: Lists Caltex petroleum sales outside the Philippines during April.
subfiles.summary: Reports bunker fuel deliveries to several vessels and a small lubricating oil delivery at Iloilo.

subfiles.title: Tide Water April diesel sales report
subfiles.from: E. C. Hoffman, Tide Water Associated Oil Company
subfiles.about: Reports April diesel sales to two Japanese fishermen.
subfiles.summary: Sales totaled 9.5 and 30.3 tons for operators with one and three launches respectively.

subfiles.title: Asiatic Petroleum French vessel deliveries
subfiles.about: Lists April and May oil deliveries to French vessels.
subfiles.summary: April deliveries totaled 2,500.53 long tons; a further 459.23 tons was delivered May 2.

subfiles.title: Standard-Vacuum April bunker report
subfiles.from: L. L. Rocke, Standard-Vacuum Oil Company
subfiles.about: Reports no April deliveries to Japanese-flag vessels and lists deliveries to French vessels.
subfiles.summary: Promises monthly reports and notice of abnormal Japanese or Messageries Maritimes demands.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru itinerary from Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Kurama Maru's planned July 1 departure.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived June 27 and was bound for Yokohama via Brazilian ports, Panama Canal, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Kurama Maru itinerary
subfiles.about: Relays the Kurama Maru's planned route from Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Tuck's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru arrival at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the Rakuyo Maru's arrival, cargo, passengers, and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Los Angeles with artificial silk and merchandise; 24 passengers disembarked.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Rakuyo Maru arrival
subfiles.about: Relays the Rakuyo Maru's Manzanillo arrival and planned sailing.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the cargo and passenger report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports the Seia Maru's arrival from Rio de Janeiro and planned departure for Cristóbal.
subfiles.summary: Arrived July 1; departure was scheduled for July 2.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Seia Maru movement
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru's La Guaira movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Breuer's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Bills of health for five Japanese vessels
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health issued to Japanese vessels bound for U.S. and Philippine ports.
subfiles.summary: Names Hif, Kyokko, Heiyo, Hilo, and Ganges and their destinations.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of bills of health
subfiles.about: Relays the bills of health and vessel destinations.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Sokobin's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Bordeaux Maru requisition
subfiles.from: Grew, Tokyo, quoting Allison in Osaka
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese government's requisition of the Bordeaux Maru.
subfiles.summary: The vessel had been scheduled to sail for San Francisco July 5.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Bordeaux Maru requisition
subfiles.about: Relays the Bordeaux Maru requisition.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Grew's telegram quoting Allison.

subfiles.title: Janamuru sailing from Santos
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese steamer's Santos arrival and departure for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Buenos Aires June 29 and sailed via Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Santos vessel sailing
subfiles.about: Relays the Japanese steamer's Santos itinerary.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase renders the vessel name as Nanamuru.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru and Matumoto departures
subfiles.about: Reports sailings of the Buenos Aires Maru and Matumoto.
subfiles.summary: Buenos Aires Maru headed toward the Brazilian coast; Matumoto reportedly sailed for Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of two Yokohama departures
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires Maru and Matumoto routes.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Yamashimo bill of health
subfiles.about: Reports a bill of health for the Yamashimo bound for Seattle.
subfiles.summary: The telegram is undated; it was received July 2.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Yamashimo bill of health
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamashimo's health certificate and destination.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Allison's undated report.

subfiles.title: Four vessel departures from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports departures toward Seattle, San Pedro, Wellington, and Bombay.
subfiles.summary: Names Hie, tanker Rikko, Yamagiku, and Toyooka.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of four vessel departures
subfiles.about: Relays four Yokohama vessel departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Sinkoku tanker departure
subfiles.about: Reports the tanker Sinkoku's departure for San Pedro.
subfiles.summary: The tanker sailed June 30.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Sinkoku departure
subfiles.about: Relays a tanker's June 30 departure for San Pedro.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report.

subfiles.title: Kaizyo and Heiyo departures
subfiles.about: Reports the Kaizyo and Heiyo sailings.
subfiles.summary: Kaizyo sailed for San Luis; Heiyo headed toward western South America via Hawaii and San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Kaizyo and Heiyo departures
subfiles.about: Relays two Yokohama vessel departures.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase renders Heiyo as Iyo.

subfiles.title: Nozima Maru cargo and withheld clearance
subfiles.about: Reports the Nozima Maru's cargo and proposed withholding of clearance.
subfiles.summary: Besides chrome ore, the vessel carried coconut oil and hemp cleared without export licenses. Clearance would be withheld until the cargo was unloaded unless instructed otherwise.

subfiles.title: Copy of Nozima Maru cargo telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Nozima Maru cargo and clearance report.
subfiles.summary: Copy of Manila telegram 283.

subfiles.title: Approval of withholding Nozima Maru clearance
subfiles.about: Approves the action described in Manila telegram 283.
subfiles.summary: States, “Your action approved.”

subfiles.title: Awazisan Maru departure from Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Awazisan Maru's departure toward Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived June 22 and was reported departing July 3 via Panama Canal and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Awazisan Maru departure
subfiles.about: Relays the reported Awazisan Maru departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Tuck's initial report; a later telegram corrects the sailing date.

subfiles.title: Hong Kong report of departure for Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports a vessel's July 1 departure for Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: The vessel name is unclear in the OCR; the telegram also mentions Thailand.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru and Kiyokawa Maru cargoes
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese vessels' sailings and mineral cargoes loaded at Manzanillo.
subfiles.summary: Rakuyo Maru carried mercury for Yokohama. Kiyokawa Maru loaded lead and mercury for Kobe, displacing cement intended for Punta Arenas.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Manzanillo mineral cargoes
subfiles.about: Relays the Rakuyo Maru and Kiyokawa Maru departures and cargoes.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Schraud's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Unconfirmed Osaka Shosen Kaisha recall
subfiles.about: Reports an unconfirmed order recalling Osaka Shosen Kaisha ships to Japan.
subfiles.summary: British intelligence said ships north of the Equator were to turn back immediately, while those to the south should return as best they could. They were reportedly to avoid U.S. ports and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Kurama Maru at Rio Grande
subfiles.about: Reports the Kurama Maru's arrival at Rio Grande and departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The vessel loaded no cargo and was to travel via Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Kurama Maru at Rio Grande
subfiles.about: Relays the Kurama Maru's Rio Grande stop.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Braddock's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Florida Maru sailing and canceled requisitioned vessels
subfiles.about: Reports the Florida Maru's departure and canceled sailings of two requisitioned ships.
subfiles.summary: Florida Maru left for Seattle without cargo or passengers. Kimikawa and Kyushu sailings were canceled after reported government requisition.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Kobe vessel changes
subfiles.about: Relays Florida Maru's sailing and the two canceled departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Warner's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Naruto Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Naruto Maru's Valparaíso arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived from Arica July 1 and sailed for Kobe via Los Angeles July 3.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Valparaíso vessel movement
subfiles.about: Relays the Valparaíso arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase reads the vessel name as Haruto Maru; the source telegram names Naruto Maru.

subfiles.title: Yamahagi departure from Wallaroo
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamahagi's departure from Wallaroo for Dairen.
subfiles.summary: The departure occurred July 4.

subfiles.title: Copy of Yamahagi departure telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the Yamahagi departure report.
subfiles.summary: Copy of the Melbourne telegram.

subfiles.title: Correction to Awazisan Maru sailing date
subfiles.about: Corrects the earlier report of the Awazisan Maru's departure.
subfiles.summary: The delayed vessel sailed July 5.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of corrected Awazisan Maru sailing
subfiles.about: Relays the Awazisan Maru's corrected departure date.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Tuck's correction for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Canceled Bordeaux Maru and Nozima Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports canceled Los Angeles sailings after reported Japanese government requisitions.
subfiles.summary: Names Bordeaux Maru and Nozima Maru.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of canceled Kobe sailings
subfiles.about: Relays the Bordeaux Maru and Nozima Maru cancellations.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Warner's requisition report.

subfiles.title: No recent Japanese vessel movements in New Zealand
subfiles.about: Reports the absence of recent Japanese vessel movements in New Zealand jurisdiction.
subfiles.summary: Naval staff knew of none since the previously reported Sydney Maru sailing.

subfiles.title: Copy of New Zealand vessel movement telegram
subfiles.about: Duplicates the report of no recent Japanese vessel movements.
subfiles.summary: Copy of Cox's telegram.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru at Callao
subfiles.to: Secretary of State, for Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports the Takaoka Maru's arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Arrived July 3 from Valparaíso via Tambode Mora and departed July 4 toward Kobe.

subfiles.title: Recall of seven Japanese ships
subfiles.about: Reports instructions to expedite loading of seven ships recalled to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Two ships were said to be omitting scheduled calls at Santos and Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of seven-ship recall
subfiles.about: Relays the report of seven recalled Japanese ships.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Caffery's telegram for the Navy.

subfiles.title: Second Navy paraphrase of seven-ship recall
subfiles.about: Again relays the recall and expedited loading report.
subfiles.summary: Confirmation copy of the Navy paraphrase.

subfiles.title: Turuga Maru departure for Shanghai
subfiles.about: Reports the Turuga Maru's departure for Shanghai.
subfiles.summary: The departure occurred July 3.

subfiles.title: Navy paraphrase of Turuga Maru departure
subfiles.about: Relays the Turuga Maru's Shanghai departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Bruins's report for the Navy.

subfiles.title: FBI letter on Osaka Shosen Kaisha routing
subfiles.about: Reports confidential information about a route change for Osaka Shosen Kaisha ships leaving South America.
subfiles.summary: Agents reportedly instructed ships sailing for Japan to use Panama rather than South Africa.
